coverage.target: NFR1.1, NFR1.2 — AuthUnit's sign-in and admin-check latency targets, minted under NFR1's own sub-ID namespace per the stage's ID-inheritance convention (corrected at this stage's review, R-03; previously mismarked N/A while still using NFR1's numbering, which was self-contradictory)
NFR3 (payment-data handling) belongs to donation-unit; AuthUnit has no payment surface
NFR3.3 (data protection covers personal-data encryption at rest/in transit)

NFR3.5 (services/-layer access boundary and mandatory self-review before merging sign-in/permission changes) — corrected at this stage's review, R-02; previously pointed at NFR3.2, which covers only the authorization/RBAC model and did not substantively address either half of NFR6
Accessibility (WCAG AA baseline) is a UI-rendering concern owned by flutter-app-unit; AuthUnit has no UI of its own beyond invoking Cognito's hosted UI
Testing methodology/coverage floor is a cross-cutting Build and Test concern, not a Unit-level NFR target

note: scalability-requirements.md (NFR-SC.1) and observability-requirements.md (NFR-OBS.1-4) are intentionally outside the NFR1-NFR8 inheritance chain above: inception's requirements.md defines no scalability or observability NFR for this project, so both files use Unit-local IDs rather than a minted inception sub-ID (added at this stage's review, R-04).
